label: There is at most one maximum in being: any two beings that are…, by Reductio-with-excluded-middle
meaning: If one maximum in being were other than another, the other, being maximal, would cause its being (genus principle at esse), and so be more a being than it (Metaphysics II.1); but nothing is more a being than a maximum. So the two are not distinct, and by excluded middle they are the same.
